satelliteNote: Each planner tab has satellite tabs that SPILL its control panel into themselves and read the switches there. Five controls sat unwired for the whole port because the tab that shows a control is not the tab that reads it. None of these tabs is swept: the anchors below are the cells actually read, and everything else on them is unenumerated.

satelliteTabs.cellsRead: EJ2:FB4, FB2:FL4, EJ5:FE5 (all 20 UW sims), FH5, BO4:CQ5 (all 29 level columns, formulas AND values), GQ4:HT5, GK5:GO5, FM2:GO2, FO5, A6:M6, AT4:AY27, AK3, BC3, AT12
satelliteTabs.notSwept: The tab is now read for every band that carries logic: hide row, all simulations, all level columns, the matrix header and anchor, and the module ROI columns. Unread: rows 6 and below (fill-down of the row-5 shapes), and the CR:GO ROI columns other than FO, GK, GL, GM, GN, GO.
satelliteTabs.finding: Hide UW Cooldown (4) is NOT uniform: it appears on DW Cooldown (EL2) and SM Cooldown (ER2) only. PS Cooldown (EZ2) and ILM Cooldown (FD2) do not mention it. AY33 (CF Slow) has a SECOND consumer here, FF2, which removes the CF columns rather than scaling them. Reading all twenty confirmed every column passes $AY$23, and turned up three things the assumption would have flattened: IDS_UW_COUNT()<=8 gates exactly the four UW+ stats (SM Cover Fire, SL Light Range, PS Death Creep, ILM Charged Mines); SL Angle stops at a VALUE CEILING (base+substat>=90) rather than a missing cost; and the four ILM columns all read FB$2 as their hide flag instead of their own. Level columns: 24 UW stats parse VALUE(LEFT(IDS_UW_LEVEL(...), 2)) - a two-character parse - and five UW+ stats wrap it in IFERROR(..., -1), so -1 is the LOCKED sentinel, not 0. 29 level columns and 29 ROI columns but only 28 simulations: Assist Module Bonus - Cannon has its ROI computed directly at GK5, dividing by CS5 where every other ROI divides by $EE5. The four assist module columns cap at hard levels (69/69/99/69) and never call EPG_UW_TARGET_LEVEL.
satelliteTabs.levelSource: VALUE(LEFT(IDS_UW_LEVEL(...), 2)) - parsed out of a string, two characters

satelliteTabs.cellsRead: A1:M6, EZ2:FY2, BO4:CN5, EZ5:FX5 (ALL 25 ROI columns), FZ4:GY4
satelliteTabs.notSwept: Rows 6 and below (fill-down), and the EG:EY intermediate columns.
satelliteTabs.levelSource: mixed: mirrored cells (=BI8, =BC45), cross-tab =eDamage!BP5 into the SOURCE tab's calc row (BP is past the AK3:BN77 mirror), and function calls IDS_MOD_CANNON_LEVEL / IDS_WSE_PRESET_LEVEL
satelliteTabs.finding: Its 25 level columns use FOUR sources at once: mirrored cells (=BI8, =BC45), cross-tab references into eDamage's own calc row (=eDamage!BP5 - BP is PAST the AK3:BN77 mirror, so it cannot come through it), and two function calls (IDS_MOD_CANNON_LEVEL, IDS_WSE_PRESET_LEVEL). Its ROI columns end *$EF$3, the same coin-scale normaliser pattern eHP Coins uses with $CQ$3. All 25 ROI columns read. FF5 (Cash Bonus) divides by $CT5 where the other 24 divide by $EC5. The module columns FN/FO pass EPG_MODULE_LEVEL_LIMIT(AL$4) while the lab and mastery columns pass $AY$27 - two different horizons on one tab.

satelliteTabs.cellsRead: A1:M6, DK2:DU2, DW2:EG5, AK3:BC3, AT12, BO4:BY5
satelliteTabs.notSwept: Everything else. The eleven upgrade columns EI:ES and their level columns BO:BY were not read past row 5.
satelliteTabs.finding: All ten hide flags are the SAME expression, =$AX$19="Attack Disso". The keys path reads exactly one control and no hide switch. It also reads eDamage!AI21 as a plain cross-tab reference, because column AI is LEFT of the AK3 mirror and outside it. Levels are INFERRED BY DIVISION: =BM8/5%, the vault stat over its per-level step, with a different step per stat (5%, 1%, 5%, 2%, 5%, 5%, 4%, 5%, 4%, 4%, 5%). Nothing stores the vault level; a stat that is not an exact multiple of its step yields a fractional level.
satelliteTabs.levelSource: DIVISION: =BM8/5% - the vault stat over its per-level step, so the level is inferred, not stored

satelliteTabs.cellsRead: A6:H6, DM2:EF2, AM3, BA3:BP4, BQ4:CE5, EG4:EZ5, DW5:DX5, EA5:EB5
satelliteTabs.notSwept: Rows 6 and below, the CF:CZ intermediate columns, and the EG:EZ matrix past row 5.
satelliteTabs.finding: Level columns BQ5:CD5 read STRAIGHT FROM CELLS (=BL15, =BM15) off the BD3 anchor - no VALUE(LEFT(...)) string parse, unlike eDamage Stone. CA5 "UW CD" is not a level at all: it is MAX(300-10*level, 200-10*level, 300-10*level) in SECONDS. DW5 is a BUNDLE upgrade that buys the GT, BH and DW cooldowns together for the SUM of their next-level costs. Five mastery columns have no level column and read a precomputed ROI off the eEcon panel.

satelliteTabs.offset: ONE COLUMN. Tab column AY is eEcon AZ. Reading letters straight across lands one column early on a different control.
satelliteTabs.cellsRead: A1:M6, AI3:AK5, AL1:AZ16, BA3:BE4, BP4:BU5, BV4:CJ6, CL2:CR5, CS4:CY5
satelliteTabs.notSwept: Rows 7 and below, and the CK/CY/CZ columns.
satelliteTabs.finding: ALL THREE anchors are offset by one column, not just the panel one. The ROI direction FLIPS within the band: CL5 is (New/Old-1)/Dur for the Workshop Utility multiplier, CM5:CQ5 are (Old/New-1)/Dur for the five COST columns. One form everywhere is wrong for five of six. The CD6:CH6 "Coins Saved" columns are Old-New, an absolute, not a ratio.

satelliteTabs.finding: TWO anchors on one tab - finding one does not account for the panel. The whole stone path is three columns (assist module substats armor and generator, assist bonus armor) and only the third carries a hide flag.

satelliteTabs.cellsRead: A1:M6, CY2:DK2, AL3, AJ21:AJ22, BO4:CA5, CY5:DK5, DL4:DX5
satelliteTabs.notSwept: Rows 6 and below (fill-down), and the CB:CX intermediate columns.
satelliteTabs.finding: Reads two DERIVED eHP cells that look like controls: AO5 (='_IDS'!BL2, assist enabled) and AY20 (=AND(IDS_CARD_MASTERY(AT19), AY16, AY19), Health Mastery active). Also tests REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT($AM$4), "^None") against a cell whose formula can only yield "All ..." or "" - that clause is unreachable. Module levels come from 'Master Sheet'!I23 and !I29 - a cross-tab read of a tab that is not the planner. I23 is the Primary Module - Armor level, which is also what eHP!AM4 tests with >159, so that threshold is a module level, not a wave or a tier. ROI band read in full: every column ends *$CQ$3, the coin-scale normaliser named in the G4 header. The two module columns gate on BU5<160 and BU5>=300 - the same 160 threshold as eHP!AM4 - so the module path only plans between levels 160 and 299.
satelliteTabs.levelSource: mixed: mirrored cells (=BI6, =BC19) AND cross-tab ='Master Sheet'!I23 for module levels
